Tap the option you think is right.

Work it out on paper first. Then reveal the solution one step at a time.

Formula / idea Turn the cosine into the sine of an angle in [−π2,π2]\left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right][−2π​,2π​], the range of sin⁡−1x\sin^{-1}xsin−1x.

    Remove whole turns of 2π2\pi2π.

    cos⁡33π5=cos⁡(6π+3π5)=cos⁡3π5\cos\dfrac{33\pi}{5} = \cos\left(6\pi + \dfrac{3\pi}{5}\right) = \cos\dfrac{3\pi}{5}cos533π​=cos(6π+53π​)=cos53π​cos⁡33π5=cos⁡(6π+3π5)=cos⁡3π5\displaystyle \cos\dfrac{33\pi}{5} = \cos\left(6\pi + \dfrac{3\pi}{5}\right) = \cos\dfrac{3\pi}{5}cos533π​=cos(6π+53π​)=cos53π​
  2. 2

    Write the cosine as a sine, using cos⁡θ=sin⁡(π2−θ)\cos\theta = \sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2} - \theta\right)cosθ=sin(2π​−θ).

    cos⁡3π5=sin⁡(π2−3π5)=sin⁡(−π10)\cos\dfrac{3\pi}{5} = \sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2} - \dfrac{3\pi}{5}\right) = \sin\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{10}\right)cos53π​=sin(2π​−53π​)=sin(−10π​)cos⁡3π5=sin⁡(π2−3π5)=sin⁡(−π10)\displaystyle \cos\dfrac{3\pi}{5} = \sin\left(\dfrac{\pi}{2} - \dfrac{3\pi}{5}\right) = \sin\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{10}\right)cos53π​=sin(2π​−53π​)=sin(−10π​)
  3. 3

    −π10∈[−π2,π2]-\dfrac{\pi}{10} \in \left[-\dfrac{\pi}{2}, \dfrac{\pi}{2}\right]−10π​∈[−2π​,2π​], so sin⁡−1\sin^{-1}sin−1 and sin⁡\sinsin cancel.

    sin⁡−1(sin⁡(−π10))=−π10\sin^{-1}\left(\sin\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{10}\right)\right) = -\dfrac{\pi}{10}sin−1(sin(−10π​))=−10π​sin⁡−1(sin⁡(−π10))=−π10\displaystyle \sin^{-1}\left(\sin\left(-\dfrac{\pi}{10}\right)\right) = -\dfrac{\pi}{10}sin−1(sin(−10π​))=−10π​

  4. 4

    Hence the value is −π10-\dfrac{\pi}{10}−10π​. Option (D).

Answer(D) −π10\displaystyle -\dfrac{\pi}{10}−10π​

Tap the option you think is right.

Work it out on paper first. Then reveal the solution one step at a time.

Formula / idea Both conditions must hold: the root needs x−1≥0x - 1 \ge 0x−1≥0, and sin⁡−1t\sin^{-1}tsin−1t needs −1≤t≤1-1 \le t \le 1−1≤t≤1.

  1. 1

    The square root is defined only when x−1≥0x - 1 \ge 0x−1≥0, and then it is never negative.

    x−1≥0\sqrt{x - 1} \ge 0x−1​≥0
  2. 2

    sin⁡−1\sin^{-1}sin−1 needs its input in [−1,1][-1, 1][−1,1]; with the root ≥0\ge 0≥0:

    0≤x−1≤10 \le \sqrt{x - 1} \le 10≤x−1​≤1
  3. 3

    Square each part.

    0≤x−1≤1  ⇒  1≤x≤20 \le x - 1 \le 1 \;\Rightarrow\; 1 \le x \le 20≤x−1≤1⇒1≤x≤20≤x−1≤1  ⇒  1≤x≤2\displaystyle 0 \le x - 1 \le 1 \;\Rightarrow\; 1 \le x \le 20≤x−1≤1⇒1≤x≤2
    1
  4. 4

    Hence the domain is [1,2][1, 2][1,2]. Option (A).

Answer(A) [1,2]\displaystyle [1, 2][1,2]

Watch out Choosing [−1,1][-1, 1][−1,1]: that is the domain of sin⁡−1t\sin^{-1}tsin−1t, not of f(x)f(x)f(x).
